subject: Post-call: security/compliance follow-up SIG questionnaire initiation & clarifying Qs
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: security/compliance follow-up - SIG questionnaire initiation & clarifying Qs

Hi Maya - great to meet today, thanks for the time. As discussed on the call, we want to kick off the vendor security questionnaire so your security team can validate Redwood for your patient-data workflows.

Next steps from our side:
- I attached our completed SIG Lite template (attached) which covers the majority of standard controls.
- Can you confirm whether Acme prefers the full SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet or a PDF summary?
- A couple of clarifying questions from the call (below) - if you can flag owners on your side that would help speed the review.

Clarifying questions:
1) Data residency: you mentioned some EU-hosted data for clinical research. Do you expect Redwood to keep EU data within EU regions for this integration, or is cross-region storage acceptable under your controls?
2) HIPAA: will Acme require a BAA for the pilot, or only once production data is onboarded?
3) Pen tests / attestation window: what is your internal SLA for reviewing vendor attestations (SOC 2 / penetration test reports)?

Attached: Redwood_SIG_Template.pdf (we filled the standard SIG questions), redwood_security_factsheet.pdf (high-level architecture + SOC 2 status).

If it helps, I can route any SOC 2 / penetration test questions to Nikhil (cc'd), who manages our compliance pack. Proposed timeline: we can turn around more detailed answers within 3 business days once we confirm the preferred SIG format and any scoped exclusions.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SIG_Template.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood_security_factsheet.pdf]

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: security/compliance follow-up - SIG questionnaire initiation & clarifying Qs

Hi Camila - thanks for the summary and for sending the SIG Lite! A few notes from our security team: they prefer the full SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet so we can map answers into our vendor portal. Can you provide the XLSX version of the SIG (or a link to the completed spreadsheet)?

Answers to your clarifying Qs from Acme side:
- Data residency: for clinical research patient PHI we need processing in the US or EU depending on the project. We'll flag specific projects that require EU-only processing; for the pilot, US-only is OK.
- HIPAA / BAA: we will need a BAA signed before you ingest any PHI in prod. Pilot data can be de-identified - engineering can confirm.
- Attestation review SLA: security typically asks for a 7-10 business day window to review a vendor SIG/SOC pack.

Can you also include the contact for who will fill the SIG spreadsheet and a single point of contact for follow-ups? I put security@acmehealth.com on cc to loop them in.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Sr. Security Program Manager
Acme Health

Hi Maya - thanks for the quick turnaround and clarifications - really helpful.

We can absolutely provide the completed SIG in XLSX. Nikhil will be the primary point-of-contact for completing the full spreadsheet and can share our SOC 2 report and latest pentest summary once we confirm the level of redaction you require.

Action items from Redwood:
- Nikhil (cc) to own the SIG spreadsheet completion - target 3 business days once we get any specific scoping notes from Acme (EU-only projects, exclusions).
- I'll upload the XLSX to a secure share and send a link to security@acmehealth.com.
- We will include our SOC 2 Type II report and pentest summary; please confirm the preferred method (SFTP, protected Drive link, or vendor portal upload).

A couple of clarifying Qs from our compliance team before we deliver the full SIG:
- For EU-only projects: do you want us to mark specific control answers as "not applicable" if processing is disallowed, or would you prefer comments in the SIG to indicate geographic constraints?
- For the BAA: should we send a standard Redwood BAA draft to legal@acmehealth.com or do you have a template you prefer?

If it's helpful I can schedule a 30-minute sync between our compliance teams to walk through any high-risk controls.

Best,
